name: Create Account
summary: New user creates a Base account with email, OTP verification, and basename registration.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.description: Welcome screen with Create Account and Sign In buttons.

steps.title: Enter Email
steps.description: Enter email screen with email input field.

steps.title: OTP Verification
steps.description: OTP verification screen with 6-digit code entry sent to email.

steps.title: Choose Username
steps.description: Choose username screen for basename registration (name.base.eth).

steps.title: Username Entered
steps.description: Username entered (d-mysten) with Claim button enabled.

steps.title: Home
steps.description: Home screen after successful account creation with $0 balance and empty token list.

notes: Account creation grants a basename (name.base.eth). Wallet starts with zero balance.
